Amsterdam Pop-ups: the interactive guide with map, filters and Dutch version

Amsterdam pop-ups this week: 16 – 22 Nov

94 temporary and one-off events: food, art, family and culture, from markets and supper clubs to comedy, music and nightlife. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.
